pr.title: 424242 - Gateway enforces usage quotas
pr.author: sam-dev
pr.body:
This pull request makes the gateway read monthlyBudget and usagePlanTier from the usage record and apply the per-team rate limit.

It adds a quota alert setting with its schema entry.

ruleFiles..github/copilot-instructions.md:
# Copilot instructions for acme-platform-gateway

## Pipelines
- Every file in `.ci/templates/` must be prefixed with its tool, `terraform-` or `bicep-`.

## YAML
Always use the `.yaml` extension. Never use `.yml`. Existing `.yml` files under `.github/` keep their names.

## Configuration
Whenever a key is added or removed, you **must** update `config/<deployment>/config.schema.json` in the same pull request.

## Terraform
Always give variables a `description` and `type`.

- **Keep modules focused**: one module, one job.
